_comment: Edge overlay. Merged over manifests/base.json by scripts/build.mjs.
Edge is Chromium, so it runs the Chrome build essentially unchanged — the
only reason it gets its own target is `key`. Edge Add-ons assigns its own
extension ID and rejects a package carrying one, and an ID pinned for
Chrome is meaningless in a different browser's storage namespace anyway.
So this overlay is the Chrome one minus the key.
